description: NaMnO₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/amd space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-11°. There are four shorter (2.31 Å) and two longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mn is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-11°. There are four shorter (1.98 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Mn atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
